result.title: Testing concept-level audits of melanoma classifiers with diffusion counterfactuals and matched positive controls
result.comment: 25 pages, 7 figures, 9 tables. Under review at Scientific Reports. Code and data at https://github.com/srahman7900/melanoma-concept-audit
result.summary: Concept-based explanations of melanoma classifiers are rarely tested against controls with known targets. We built a counterfactual audit from a diffusion model conditioned on seven 7-point checklist concepts and tested it with such controls. Colour-calibrated start noise reduced colour outliers from 78.5-84.8\% to 6.6-13.3\%. Four of seven knobs were target-dominant but also changed other concepts. Quartile-based positive controls were confounded, and the audit failed its pre-specified rule. It recovered the targets of all 16 controls matched on the generator's pseudo-labels and of 12 of 12 controls labelled by a second evaluator, for three concepts; concept activation vectors recovered fewer (11 of 16). In 18 permuted-label classifiers, significant sweep responses and target rankings also arose, whereas standardised effect margins separated the controls from these null classifiers. The pigmentation sweep raised the melanoma logit in 15 of 15 ISIC 2020 classifiers (+3.12 on average) and 6 of 6 HAM10000 classifiers (+4.01), about four times the null response in scale-free units; the regression effect did not transfer. An exploratory decomposition, evaluated against the controls, suggested that knob cross-talk partly hides vascular responses. Matched controls and null classifiers are practical checks of concept audits.

AI.brief_summary: 论文以条件于七项7点检查表概念的扩散模型构造反事实审计，并引入匹配正控制与置换标签的空分类器，检验黑色素瘤分类器的概念解释能否对应到目标概念，发现多数概念旋钮存在跨概念串扰。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「匹配控制＋零模型分类器＋标准化效应量」的因果审计协议，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真正依赖特定视觉证据，以及概念串扰造成的归因混淆；在推理轨迹上如何迁移仍需核查。
